notes.title: TRANSLATION / LANGUAGE REFRESH
notes.content:
We’ve just rolled out a refresh to all supported translations!


Our original localization relied heavily on automated translation tools, which unfortunately led to some awkward or unnatural phrasing. Based on community feedback, we’ve gone back and reworked all 9 supported languages to provide a smoother, more natural experience.



While this update represents a significant improvement, we know it may not be perfect. As a two-person team, our goal is to keep making progress step by step and we’ll continue refining with your feedback.



🌍 Updated languages include:



English

Spanish

French

German

Italian

Portuguese (Brazilian)

Russian

Japanese

Simplified Chinese



This refresh should make dialogue and menus feel clearer and more immersive across the board. If you notice areas that can still be improved, we’d love to hear from you! Your input directly helps us polish The Living Remain for players worldwide.



Thank you for supporting us and helping us make the game better for everyone!

Five Finger Studios

But today, we’re celebrating progress:

Help us grow, and watch what comes next!

notes.title: The Living Remain 1.0 – Leaving Early Access!
notes.content:
Survivors,

The time has come! After years of hard work, countless late nights, and an unwavering passion for crafting an unforgettable VR experience, The Living Remain is officially leaving Early Access!🎉

This journey began as a dream—just the two of us, husband and wife, pouring everything we had into creating a thrilling action-adventure VR game. We’ve tackled every challenge, from developing immersive mechanics to fine-tuning every detail, all to bring you a game that we’re truly proud of. And now, thanks to your support, feedback, and patience, we’re making that dream a reality.

What’s New?
This major update brings several exciting enhancements and crucial fixes to ensure a smoother, more immersive experience.

Enhancements

 A switch to OpenXR. This brings a major performance boost for some users. It took a lot of effort, but we wanted to make sure that we exited Early Access with stability and performance in mind.
 Updated various textures throughout the game. This includes re-authoring some as well as increasing the resolution for more detail.
 Updated lighting across multiple levels for a more immersive and dynamic atmosphere.
 Physics optimizations to reduce CPU load and improve overall performance.
 Added ability to pause the game with the menu button. A small change, but a highly requested one!
 Improved undead attacks when crawling, making them even more intense.
 Drastically reduced invisible walls in the dirt lot area, allowing for better movement and exploration.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed issue with bullet trajectory through glass. Bullets now continue in the proper direction.
 Fixed issue where players could not store large weapons while walking. No more awkward inventory struggles!
 Fixed undead teleporting out of the container in the first level. They should stay where they belong.
 Fixed issue where some users were unable to load into the next level. Progression should be smooth now.
 Fixed issue with subtitles not always working. Now you won’t miss a word.
 Fixed issue where hands would be shaky for some players. Improved hand stability for better immersion.
 Fixed issue that could cause players to not progress near the train. No more getting stuck!
 And many other smaller bugs that we can’t even remember.


Note: Index Users, we are currently working on full support which will be in the next update!

A Heartfelt Thank You
We couldn’t have done this without you—our incredible community. Your feedback, encouragement, and dedication have kept us pushing forward, ensuring that The Living Remain delivers the best experience possible.

This may be the end of Early Access, but it’s far from the end of our journey. We’ll continue supporting the game, listening to your feedback, and refining the experience. For now, we hope you enjoy this update and everything it brings.

Thank you for being part of this adventure. We’ll see you in the fight! 💀🔥

– Stephen & Pamela Marshall
Five Finger Studios

notes.title: Official bHaptics Support
notes.content:
🎉 Exciting News 🎉

We're thrilled to announce that a brand new update is now live, and it brings a whole new level of immersion to your VR experience with bHaptics support!

Now, every action you take in The Living Remain will be felt like never before, thanks to the integration of bHaptics technology. From the subtle vibrations of footsteps to the exhilarating feedback of intense combat, every moment is now more lifelike and immersive than ever.

We've worked hard to ensure that this update not only enhances your gameplay but also adds a new layer of realism that truly transports you into the heart of the game's world.

Huge shout out to the bHaptics team for working with us and making this possible!

If you haven't tried out bHaptics and/or want to know more about it. Visit them at bHaptics Website

Thank you for your continued support, and we can't wait to hear your feedback on this exciting new addition!

Also, a special shout out to Florian for all of the support!

notes.title: Full Index / Windows Mixed Reality Support and More!
notes.content:
This update was a long time coming. 

After many months of hard work, it’s finally here! To say it was a lot of work is an understatement. We ripped out our old interaction systems and built in a new enhanced version. This alone was a ton of work as it touches almost every system within the game. This new version is more advanced and makes interacting within the world much more enjoyable and realistic.

In addition we updated the version of the engine we run on and implemented some new features to enhance the game.

We also updated some models and enhanced textures for some objects within the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32995586/8b9d570dcb61bcba01e15b222724c19c9a25c1da.gif

MAJOR FEATURES
* Official Index Support - This will include full finger tracking for Index players.

* Official Windows Mixed Reality Support - Full support for WMR.

* Improved interaction with the world - We have completely redesigned the interaction system to allow more grips to be placed on items, which will give better and more natural looking grips to existing items. In addition, we have added physics based grips, which will allow a much more fined grain grab for larger objects via dynamic hand/finger posing (similar to Lone Echo).

* Massive increase of interactable objects - We have also made a lot more things able to be picked up and manipulated. This includes boxes and other items that can be picked up with two hands that were previous moveable, but not able to be picked up.

* Added ability to play seated - There have been a few players that would rather play sitting down and some recent games released support this. We've been working on adding this into the game.

* Adding ability to crouch - Players now have the ability to crouch via controller button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32995586/d517b6c16dee35661546f5f027aff068325758b4.gif

ADDITIONAL FEATURES

FIRE ARMS
We have also improved the weapons handling of all guns. They now handle more realistically and have improved collisions within the world.


 All guns now have physics-based recoil
 Grab pistol gun slides in multiple places.
 Stabilize all guns by holding it with two hands
 Option to grab magazines directly from the guns


QUALITY OF LIFE ENHANCEMENTS

Improved leaning over objects. You can now lean over lower objects and continue to use the thumb stick to back away from it.
Players will no longer get stuck in the world geometry. We have worked on a great solution for this, and it will no longer be an issue.
We have gotten the weapons grabs to be much more reliable so grabbing the gun slides, will now always use the grab button. We removed the option for using the trigger as this makes grabbing more consistent.
Improved distance grab. Picking up objects are now easier and its selection scope more accurate.
Interacting with objects are now much more forgiving and should provide a much better experience.
Rework of grab indicators. We worked on making them much less intrusive.
When emptying the revolver, only used shells get dumped. This allows players to reload for the next encounter without losing ammo.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32995586/f0dde531881f0becc7d2c5478394acfa70eff962.gif

HANDS
	We completely recreated the hands from scratch. We wanted to update them and the interactions to be much more fluid. This required us to make a new rig and textures. Hand animations are now much improved and are a lot smoother when using the controller buttons or grabbing items.

REMIXED AUDIO
	We spent some time enhancing the audio in the game to be more balanced.

BUG FIXES
There are too many to list here but some include:


 Some users having issues not being able to get into the game due to the black screen issue
 Levers not working under certain circumstances
 Two handed guns sometimes not able to go into backpack
 Gun slides not properly cocking under certain circumstances

notes.title: Current Progress
notes.content:
It's been a while since we posted, so we wanted to give everyone more information regarding the next update that we are working on.

As we mentioned, it will be a major update that will bring full Index controller support, a lot of quality of life changes to the game, new features, improved physics, and an upgraded interaction system.
It has been taking a bit to get it all done, we've had to dig deep into various systems within the game and pretty much gut them and replace them with the new systems. We are so far making good progress, but because it such a fundamental change to the game, it takes time...a lot of time. We knew this going into this change that it would be a lot of work (actually a ton of re-work!), but we want to continue to develop the game and bring more content. This sets us up to do that as it will allow us to have a much more solid foundation to move forward with.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32995586/d517b6c16dee35661546f5f027aff068325758b4.gif
Below is a list of things that will be included:


 Official Index Support - This will include full finger tracking for Index players.`
 Official Windows Mixed Reality Support - We will need some testers at some point as we don't have a WMR headset...so let us know if you are willing to do some testing once we get completed. 
 Improved interaction with the world - We have completely redesigned the interaction system to allow more grips to be placed on items, which will give better and more natural looking grips to existing items. In addition, we have added physics based grips, which will allow a much more fined grain grab for larger objects via dynamic hand/finger posing (similar to Lone Echo). 
 We have also made a lot more things able to be picked up and manipulated. This includes boxes and other items that can be picked up with two hands that were previous moveable, but not able to be picked up. 
 Added ability to play seated - There have been a few players that would rather play sitting down and some recent games released support this. We've been working on adding this into the game.
 Exploring adding a crouch button - Were not to sure how this would affect the game, but we are experimenting with it.
 Improved weapon handling - You will now have the ability to grab the pistol gun slide in multiple places.`This was a pain point for many players, so we added it as it added to realism.

 Quality of life enhancements-

 	Improved leaning over objects. You can now lean over lower objects and continue to use the thumb stick to back away from it.
 	Players will no longer get stuck in the world geometry. We have worked on a great solution for this, and it will no longer be an `issue
 	We have gotten the weapons grabs to be much more reliable so grabbing the gun slides, will now always use the grab button. We are removing the option for using the trigger. 
 	Improved distance grab. Picking up objects are now easier and its selection scope more accurate.
 	Interacting with objects are now much more forgiving and should provide a much better experience.
 	Rework of grab indicators. We are working on making them much less intrusive.

 Bug fixes - There are too many to list here but some include: 

 	Some users having issues not being able to get into the game due to the black screen issue
 	Levers not working under certain circumstances
 	Two handed guns sometimes not able to go into backpack
 	Gun slides not properly cocking under certain circumstances


By the way, this list above is some of the things we are adding. It's not a complete list...
Thanks for your continued support, we're excited to get this update completed as soon as possible. It's still a bit ways off. We'll keep you posted with another update soon!
	
Join our Discord for additional information and if you have any suggestions/ideas you want to share with us.

Five Finger Studios

Hope you’re enjoying your 4th of July weekend! We have been pretty quiet recently and for a good reason. We have had quite a few changes in the last couple of weeks. notes.content:

This weeks update brings a couple of improvements and some bug fixes. The red dot scopes now behave as they should and adjust based on the angle at which they are viewed.

We also added an adjustment as requested by the community for Snap Turning. First, we have made it more responsive. Secondly, it's now possible to control the blink duration or shut it off completely.

A big shout out to LFulciFan and other players who brought this issue to our attention, you were all instrumental in helping us track it down.

notes.title: The Days After – Update Re-Launch
notes.content:
Hello fellow gaming aficionados!!
 
It’s been some time since our last update, as we have been hard at work progressing on The Days
After.  As we continue development and move towards a near release date, we thought this would be a good time to re-engage the community and provide regular updates on game development, while receiving feedback and suggestions from your collective hours of gaming experience.
 
Like you, we are avid gamers and our goal is to deliver a VR gaming experience that players
want and deserve for their hard earned coin, without repeating the mistakes made by other
developers consumed in the grip of the cash grab.
 
First, allow me to share with you who we are, how we got here, what we are accomplishing, and
how you can help.
 
Five Finger Studios is an independent gaming company consisting of a small group of individuals.
How small? Uh…yea, well, there are two of us. Three years ago we quit our jobs and have been
focusing on the development of The Days After, full-time, with some support and mentorship
from major headset makers, and VR industry experts. No turning back now.
 
The Days After takes place in a post-event zombie apocalypse. A story driven kill-fest, using
some seen before, as well as some improved game mechanics. Well balanced puzzles that allow the player to interact with the world and utilize items to craft things to their advantage. We have also optimized the game to run and look good on a wide range of PC specifications and VR headsets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32995586/cf00a806adb435691afb66ae8a35e6929df21cbd.png
 
While in development we continue to keep an eye on new and innovative gaming techniques,
ideas, community feedback, and frankly, VR game releases. The recent game releases (we all
know what they are) as of late, have been both inspirational and impressive, and a strong catalyst for
our desire to develop a great game. Let’s be honest, we all have our own ideas of what makes a
great VR game, and we want to hear yours.
 
Every time we don on our headsets and dive into a new or sometimes old game, we
wonder…”What works? What doesn’t work? How can we make it better?”

https://media.giphy.com/media/RhBXnJ5jQAHoAZTWRG/giphy.gif
 
We take our answers to these questions and try to incorporate them into The Days After, but we can’t
do it alone.  In the name of progress and delivering the gaming experience that captures the best
of all your ideas and leaves the “what’s wrong” on the cutting room floor, we will be fully
engaging in the Steam Community Board to update you on game progress, schedules, screen
shots, game mechanics, and most importantly, solicit suggestions.  Your participation is kindly
requested.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32995586/9b6f5ecc09200d57d7c027041a0e87c830d815d4.png

In the meantime, here is a list of links to refresh your memory and keep you occupied until the
next update.  We will provide regular updates to the Steam Board, so click on
the “follow” button to make sure you don’t miss anything.


Website:
http://www.fivefingerstudios.com/thedaysafter

Trailer:
https://youtu.be/Wf3r5wIapAo
